title: Transformer-Based Warm-Starting for Feasible and Optimal Terminal Approach to Tumbling Objects with Space Manipulators
abstract: arXiv:2606.17317v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autonomous capture of a tumbling object with a space manipulator requires trajectory generation under real-time onboard constraints. However, coupled bus-arm dynamics, rotating safety geometry, and visibility requirements make the underlying optimization severely nonconvex, hence expensive to solve and sensitive to initialization. This paper develops a causal-transformer warm-start for the computationally dominant attitude-manipulator stage of a two-stage sequential convex programming (SCP) framework. Across 300 held-out scenarios evaluated on embedded hardware, the learned warm-start reduces the iterations of the second-stage SCP by up to 32% and runtime by 16% while maintaining numerical feasibility and matching the final control cost. translated_title: 基于Transformer的暖启动方法：实现空间机械臂对翻滚目标的可行且最优终端接近
translated_abstract: 使用空间机械臂自主捕获翻滚目标需要在星载实时约束下进行轨迹生成。然而，耦合的基座-机械臂动力学、旋转的安全几何约束以及可见性要求使得底层优化问题严重非凸，因此求解代价高昂且对初始化敏感。本文针对两阶段序贯凸规划（SCP）框架中计算量占主导的姿态-机械臂阶段，开发了一种因果Transformer暖启动方法。在嵌入式硬件上评估的300个保留测试场景中，学习到的暖启动方法将第二阶段SCP的迭代次数最多减少32%，运行时间减少16%，同时保持数值可行性并匹配最终控制成本。此外，本文在线性动作解码器与流匹配动作解码器之间，针对不同动作块长度和训练数据集规模进行了比较，其中流匹配解码器表现出更强的训练数据效率。
tldr: 本文提出一种因果Transformer暖启动方法，用于加速空间机械臂捕获翻滚目标的两阶段序贯凸规划求解，在嵌入式硬件上最多减少32%的迭代次数和16%的运行时间，同时保持数值可行性与控制成本，且流匹配动作解码器展现出更高的训练数据效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a causal-transformer warm-start for the two-stage sequential convex programming framework that enables space manipulators to capture tumbling objects, reducing second-stage SCP iterations by up to 32% and runtime by 16% on embedded hardware while maintaining feasibility and control cost, with flow matching action decoders demonstrating superior training-data efficiency.
